title: server-side endpoint fetch fails if both `paths.base` and `paths.assets` are specified
body:
### Describe the bug

Innocuous code like this...

```svelte
<script context="module">
  import { base } from '$app/paths';

  export async function load({ fetch }) {
    const data = await fetch(`${base}/data.json`).then(r => r.json());

    return {
      props: { data }
    }
  }
</script>
```

...will fail if _both_ `base` and `assets` are set. The internal `fetch` wrapper gets confused about what the proper URL should be.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/Rich-Harris/endpoint-fetch-repro
